title: ACh aaPanel Customizer
name: ach_customizer
ps: Native aaPanel customization with paginated site and domain inventory, plugin-owned baseline comparisons, PHP-FPM policy and opt-in verified WordPress/native-regeneration recovery, Status Pages, Nginx and FastCGI Cache tools, and Activity diagnostics.
